		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
	}
	set svc4 {
		type ipv4_addr . inet_proto . inet_service
		elements = { 192.168.7.20 . tcp . 5432 }
	}
	set allow4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
	}
	set allow6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
	}
	set deny4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
		elements = { 0.0.0.0/8, 10.0.0.0/8, 100.64.0.0/10, 127.0.0.0/8, 169.254.0.0/16, 172.16.0.0/12, 192.0.0.0/24, 192.168.0.0/16, 198.18.0.0/15, 224.0.0.0/4, 240.0.0.0/4 }
	}
	set deny6 {
		type ipv6_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
		elements = { ::/128, ::1/128, ::ffff:0.0.0.0/96, 64:ff9b::/96, 64:ff9b:1::/48, 2001::/32, 2002::/16, fc00::/7, fe80::/10, ff00::/8 }
	}
	set vmallow4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags interval
		auto-merge
		elements = { 203.0.113.0/24 }
	}
	set pinned4 {
		type ipv4_addr
		flags timeout
	}
	chain forward {
		type filter hook forward priority filter; policy drop;
		ct state invalid drop
		iifname "up0" oifname "tap0" ct state established,related accept
		iifname != "tap0" drop
		oifname != "up0" drop
		meta nfproto ipv6 drop
		ip saddr != { 172.16.0.2, 172.17.0.0/16 } drop
		ct state established,related ct mark 0x00000001 accept
		ip daddr @host4 drop
		ip6 daddr @host6 drop
		ip daddr != @vmallow4 ip daddr != @pinned4 drop
		ip daddr . meta l4proto . th dport @svc4 ct mark set 0x00000001 accept
		ip daddr @allow4 ct mark set 0x00000001 accept
		ip6 daddr @allow6 accept
		ip daddr @deny4 drop
		ip6 daddr @deny6 drop
		ct mark set 0x00000001 accept
	}
	chain prerouting {
		type nat hook prerouting priority dstnat; policy accept;
		iifname "tap0" udp dport 53 dnat ip to 172.16.0.1:53
		iifname "tap0" tcp dport 53 dnat ip to 172.16.0.1:53
	}
	chain input {
		type filter hook input priority filter; policy accept;
		iifname "tap0" ct state established,related accept
		iifname "tap0" ip saddr { 172.16.0.2, 172.17.0.0/16 } ip daddr 172.16.0.1 udp dport 53 accept

		iifname "tap0" ip saddr { 172.16.0.2, 172.17.0.0/16 } ip daddr 172.16.0.1 tcp dport 15080 accept
		iifname "tap0" drop
	}
	chain postrouting {
		type nat hook postrouting priority srcnat; policy accept;
		oifname "up0" ip saddr { 172.16.0.2, 172.17.0.0/16 } masquerade
	}
